label: A detached worker stays referenced if closeSync throws after spawn

origin.note: Built for the OAI-221 overnight tuning matrix, 2026-08-26 — never scored by any run before this corpus. This case scopes to job-spawn.mjs's unref-ordering fix only. The commit's process.exit()-truncation fix in scripts/oai-companion.mjs is deliberately dropped as out of scope for scoring: it is the same defect class as hold1-exit-code, and scoring it here too would credit one class of finding twice across the corpus.

defects.description: child.unref() is called only after the try/finally block, following closeSync(log) in the finally. If closeSync throws, the finally's exception propagates before unref() runs, leaving a successfully spawned detached child referenced — keeping this process's event loop alive on a worker the submitter has nothing further to do with.
